190	# --- claude-plans-here -----------------------------------------------------
191	# Scaffold or update project-local .claude/settings.json so Claude Code's
192	# /plan files land in ./.claude/plans/ (kept inside the repo) instead of the
193	# user-global plansDirectory. Pairs well with the agent-history-hygiene skill,
194	# which can then redact + commit the plan files alongside the diff.
195	#
196	# Also offers to import "orphan" plans — plans previously written under the
197	# global ~/.claude/plans/ that belong to this project. Detection: scan
198	# ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/*.jsonl (where Claude Code logs sessions
199	# per cwd; encoding maps '/' and '.' to '-') for Write/Edit tool_use entries
200	# whose file_path points into ~/.claude/plans/. This avoids false positives
201	# from sessions that merely *mentioned* a plan path in conversation.
202	#
203	# Usage: claude-plans-here [-f] [-y]
204	#   -f   auto-yes the settings.json merge prompt
205	#   -y   auto-yes the orphan-plan copy prompt
206	claude-plans-here() {
207		force_settings=0
208		force_orphans=0
209		while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
210			case "$1" in
211			-f) force_settings=1 ;;
212			-y) force_orphans=1 ;;
213			-h | --help)
214				echo "Usage: claude-plans-here [-f] [-y]"
215				echo "  -f   auto-yes the settings.json merge prompt"
216				echo "  -y   auto-yes the orphan-plan copy prompt"
217				return 0
218				;;
219			*)
220				echo "claude-plans-here: unknown flag '$1'" >&2
221				return 1
222				;;
223			esac
224			shift
225		done
226	
227		target=".claude/settings.json"
228		mkdir -p .claude/plans
229	
230		if [ ! -e "$target" ]; then
231			cat >"$target" <<'EOF'
232	{
233	  "plansDirectory": "./.claude/plans"
234	}
235	EOF
236			echo "Wrote $PWD/$target"
237		else
238			if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
239				echo "claude-plans-here: jq required to merge into existing $target" >&2
240				return 1
241			fi
242	
243			ans=y
244			if [ "$force_settings" = "0" ]; then
245				printf '%s exists. Merge plansDirectory into it? [y/N] ' "$target"
246				read -r ans
247			fi
248	
249			case "$ans" in
250			y | Y | yes | YES | Yes)
251				tmp="$(mktemp)" || return 1
252				if jq --arg p "./.claude/plans" '. + {plansDirectory: $p}' "$target" >"$tmp"; then
253					mv "$tmp" "$target"
254					echo "Merged plansDirectory into $PWD/$target"
255				else
256					rm -f "$tmp"
257					echo "claude-plans-here: jq failed; $target unchanged" >&2
258					return 1
259				fi
260				;;
261			esac
262		fi
263	
264		_claude_plans_here_import_orphans "$force_orphans"
265		unset force_settings force_orphans target ans tmp
266	}
267	
268	# Internal: scan ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd|encoded-git-root>/*.jsonl
269	# for Write/Edit tool_use entries that wrote into ~/.claude/plans/, list the
270	# ones still living in the global dir and not yet copied locally, prompt y/N.
271	_claude_plans_here_import_orphans() {
272		force="$1"
273		global_plans="$HOME/.claude/plans"
274		[ -d "$global_plans" ] || return 0
275	
276		# Claude Code projects/ encoding: replace each '/' and '.' with '-'.
277		enc_cwd="$(printf '%s' "$PWD" | tr '/.' '--')"
278		enc_root=""
279		if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
280			groot="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"
281			if [ -n "$groot" ] && [ "$groot" != "$PWD" ]; then
282				enc_root="$(printf '%s' "$groot" | tr '/.' '--')"
283			fi
284		fi
285	
286		proj_dirs=""
287		[ -d "$HOME/.claude/projects/$enc_cwd" ] && proj_dirs="$HOME/.claude/projects/$enc_cwd"
288		[ -n "$enc_root" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.claude/projects/$enc_root" ] &&
289			proj_dirs="$proj_dirs $HOME/.claude/projects/$enc_root"
290		[ -z "$proj_dirs" ] && return 0
291	
292		jsonl_files=""
293		for d in $proj_dirs; do
294			for f in "$d"/*.jsonl; do
295				[ -r "$f" ] || continue
296				jsonl_files="$jsonl_files $f"
297			done
298		done
299		[ -z "$jsonl_files" ] && return 0
300	
301		# Two-stage filter: only lines containing a Write/Edit tool_use, then
302		# extract any plan-path within them. Authoritative — avoids matching plan
303		# paths that merely appeared in user/assistant text.
304		re_prefix="$(printf '%s' "$global_plans" | sed 's/[.[\*^$()+?{|]/\\&/g')"
305		matches="$(
306			# shellcheck disable=SC2086
307			grep -hE '"name":"(Write|Edit)"' $jsonl_files 2>/dev/null |
308				grep -oE "${re_prefix}/[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+\.md" |
309				sort -u
310		)"
311		[ -z "$matches" ] && return 0
312	
313		candidates=""
314		count=0
315		while IFS= read -r m; do
316			[ -f "$m" ] || continue
317			base="${m##*/}"
318			[ -e ".claude/plans/$base" ] && continue
319			candidates="$candidates
320	$m"
321			count=$((count + 1))
322		done <<EOF
323	$matches
324	EOF
325		[ "$count" = 0 ] && return 0
326	
327		echo
328		echo "Found $count orphan plan(s) in ~/.claude/plans/ linked to this project:"
329		printf '%s\n' "$candidates" | while IFS= read -r m; do
330			[ -z "$m" ] && continue
331			printf '  - %s\n' "${m#$HOME/}"
332		done
333	
334		ans=y
335		if [ "$force" = "0" ]; then
336			printf 'Copy them into ./.claude/plans/ (originals kept)? [y/N] '
337			read -r ans
338		fi
339		case "$ans" in
340		y | Y | yes | YES | Yes) ;;
341		*) return 0 ;;
342		esac
343	
344		copied=0
345		printf '%s\n' "$candidates" | while IFS= read -r m; do
346			[ -z "$m" ] && continue
347			cp -n "$m" .claude/plans/ 2>/dev/null && copied=$((copied + 1))
348		done
349		echo "Copied plan(s) into $PWD/.claude/plans/"
350		unset force global_plans enc_cwd enc_root proj_dirs jsonl_files re_prefix matches candidates count m base ans copied
351	}

2	#
3	# Init order (load-bearing — see docs/shells/bash.md):

5	#   2.  /etc/bashrc source (RHEL families)
6	#   3.  ble.sh --attach=none   ← BEFORE bash-preexec / starship
7	#   4.  XDG dirs + Homebrew shellenv (mac)
8	#   5.  Bash-specific config files (history / completion / vi-mode / aliases)
9	#   6.  oh-my-bash source (after ble.sh so OMB's bash-preexec install no-ops)
10	#   7.  Shared modular layer (starship / mise / zoxide / direnv / thefuck)
11	#   8.  atuin init bash --disable-up-arrow (ble.sh handles up-arrow history)

14	#   11. ~/.bash_aliases (Debian/Ubuntu) + ~/.bashrc.d/* (RHEL family)
15	#       — backward-compat with distro skel conventions
16	#   12. .bashrc.adhoc tail (chezmoi-ignored; highest-priority user override)
17	#
18	# The ble.sh / oh-my-bash / atuin steps are presence-gated and no-op

21	# Plain bash without ble.sh + OMB still gets a fully working starship

25	# Non-interactive shells (SSH commands, cron, scp) bail out here.
26	# Anything below this guard runs only in interactive bash.

28	case $- in

145	fi
146	
147	# 11. ===========================================================
148	# Backward-compat with distro-specific user-customisation conventions:
149	#
150	#   - ~/.bash_aliases               (Ubuntu/Debian skel sources this)
151	#   - ~/.bashrc.d/*                 (RHEL/Rocky/Alma/Fedora skel loops
152	#                                    over this dir — verified in Rocky 9)
153	#
154	# Without these sources, our managed bashrc would silently strip user
155	# content that other dotfiles / distro defaults accumulated — hard to
156	# debug, hostile UX.
157	#
158	# Sourced AFTER ble-attach so any `bind -x` / `ble-bind -x` calls take
159	# effect. Sourced BEFORE `.bashrc.adhoc` (step 12) so the chezmoi-
160	# ignored adhoc tail wins on conflict.
161	# Convention: long-lived stuff goes here (or migrate to
162	# dot_config/bash/10_aliases.bash); machine-local experiments go in
163	# .bashrc.adhoc.
164	[ -r "$HOME/.bash_aliases" ] && . "$HOME/.bash_aliases"
165	if [ -d "$HOME/.bashrc.d" ]; then
166	    for _rc_file in "$HOME"/.bashrc.d/*; do
167	        [ -r "$_rc_file" ] && . "$_rc_file"
168	    done
169	    unset _rc_file
170	fi
171	
172	# 12. ===========================================================
173	# Adhoc Configuration (not tracked by chezmoi). Two-layer pattern:
174	#   12a. ~/.shellrc.adhoc — shared POSIX layer, sourced by BOTH shells.
175	#        Use this for anything portable so you don't duplicate it in
176	#        ~/.zshrc.adhoc and ~/.bashrc.adhoc.
177	#   12b. ~/.bashrc.adhoc — bash-only adhoc; can use `bind -x` / `ble-bind`,
178	#        OMB plugin tweaks, `shopt`. Layered on top — wins on conflict.
179	# Both run AFTER ble-attach + after ~/.bash_aliases / ~/.bashrc.d/*, so
180	# ble-bind / readline `bind -x` in either file takes effect.
181	# Full design: docs/shells/adhoc-and-secrets.md
182	
183	# 12a. Create shared adhoc file if it doesn't exist (sourced by both zsh+bash).
184	if [[ ! -f "$HOME/.shellrc.adhoc" ]]; then
185	    cat > "$HOME/.shellrc.adhoc" << 'SHELLRC_ADHOC_EOF'
186	# ~/.shellrc.adhoc - Personal SHARED shell customizations (not tracked by chezmoi)
187	#
188	# This file is sourced by BOTH ~/.zshrc AND ~/.bashrc. Put anything POSIX-
189	# portable here so you don't have to duplicate it in ~/.zshrc.adhoc and
190	# ~/.bashrc.adhoc.
191	#
192	# HARD RULE: POSIX-only.
193	#   - No zsh-isms: no `setopt`, `compdef`, ZLE widgets, `read -q`, `${m:t}`,
194	#     glob qualifiers, `bindkey`. Put those in ~/.zshrc.adhoc instead.
195	#   - No bash-isms: no `bind -x`, `ble-bind`, `shopt`, `complete -F`. Put
196	#     those in ~/.bashrc.adhoc instead.
197	#   - If you need shell-specific logic, dispatch via $ZSH_VERSION /
198	#     $BASH_VERSION (same convention as ~/.config/shell/*.sh):
199	#       if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then ...
200	#       elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then ...
201	#       fi
202	#
203	# Sourced AFTER ~/.shellrc.secrets, BEFORE the per-shell ~/.{zsh,bash}rc.adhoc
204	# (per-shell wins on conflict). See docs/shells/adhoc-and-secrets.md.
205	#
206	# Example:
207	# export MY_SHARED_VAR="hello from both shells"
208	# alias ll='ls -lah'
209	
210	SHELLRC_ADHOC_EOF
211	fi
212	
213	# Source shared adhoc (POSIX, both shells).
214	[ -r "$HOME/.shellrc.adhoc" ] && . "$HOME/.shellrc.adhoc"
215	
216	# 12b. Create bash-only adhoc file if it doesn't exist.
217	if [[ ! -f "$HOME/.bashrc.adhoc" ]]; then
218	    cat > "$HOME/.bashrc.adhoc" << 'ADHOC_EOF'
219	# ~/.bashrc.adhoc - Personal BASH-ONLY shell customizations (not tracked by chezmoi)
220	#
221	# Use this file for:
222	#   - Quick experiments with bash-only constructs (`bind -x`, `ble-bind`,
223	#     `shopt`, `complete -F`, OMB plugin tweaks)
224	#   - Machine-specific bash-only configurations
225	#   - Testing before adding to chezmoi-managed configs
226	#
227	# For anything POSIX-portable that should also affect zsh, prefer
228	# ~/.shellrc.adhoc instead. See docs/shells/adhoc-and-secrets.md.
229	#
230	# This file is sourced at the end of ~/.bashrc (AFTER ble-attach + after
231	# ~/.bash_aliases + AFTER ~/.shellrc.adhoc), so ble-bind / readline
232	# `bind -x` calls here will take effect, and anything you set here
233	# overrides the shared ~/.shellrc.adhoc on conflict.
234	# Changes here apply to new shell sessions (or run: source ~/.bashrc.adhoc)
235	
236	# Example:
237	# alias myalias='echo "Hello from adhoc!"'
238	# export MY_VAR="my_value"
239	
240	# To enable ble.sh's pacman-style auto-suggestion mode:
241	# bleopt complete_auto_complete=1
242	ADHOC_EOF
243	fi
244	
245	# Source bash-only adhoc (per-shell wins over ~/.shellrc.adhoc on conflict).
246	[ -r "$HOME/.bashrc.adhoc" ] && . "$HOME/.bashrc.adhoc"

```md
# zsh Startup Optimization — Cache slow completions + dedup brew shellenv

## Context

Steady-state zsh startup is currently **~700ms**;cold start ~2.5s。前一輪 profiling (`ZSH_PROF=1 zsh` + 自訂 per-file timing) 已找出 5 個明確瓶頸:

| # | 來源 | 時間 | 主因 |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | `dot_config/shell/29_marimo.sh:9-13` | **282ms** | 每次 startup 跑 `_MARIMO_COMPLETE=zsh_source marimo` (Python cold start ~520ms 的子進程) |
| P2 | `dot_config/zsh/tools/32_try.zsh:12,15` | **68ms** | 每次跑 ruby ×2(找 gem dir + `try init`) |
| P3 | `dot_config/shell/27_thefuck.sh:9` | **59ms** | 每次跑 `thefuck --alias` Python 子進程 |
| P4 | `dot_config/shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl:58-64` 與 `dot_zshrc.tmpl:92-98` / `dot_bashrc.tmpl:67-71` | **~17ms ×2 shells** | brew shellenv 在 mac 上跑兩次(zsh 與 bash 都中招) |
| P5 | `~/.zcompdump-Da-Wei's Mac mini-5.9*` 5 份舊 dump | 0ms (cosmetic) | hostname 改過後留下的孤兒檔 |

**目標**:把 P1–P4 共 ~448ms 砍掉,steady-state 從 ~700ms 降到 **~250ms** (約 -64%)。

**為何用 cache 而不是 lazy-init / 移除工具**:
- marimo / thefuck / try 都還在用,使用者沒打算停用 → 不能像 nvm 那樣延遲到 `LOAD_NVM=1`
- 完成腳本只是 `eval`-able 文字,適合 file cache(對比 `_<tool>` autoload function 適合 `~/.zfunc/`)
- 既有 canonical pattern 已存在(Bitwarden, `dot_config/zsh/tools/95_bitwarden.zsh:11-17`)— 直接 mirror,不要發明新 abstraction

## Strategy: Mirror Bitwarden 的 cache 模式 + 加 mtime 失效

既有的兩種 caching pattern:

| Pattern | 例子 | 失效機制 | 適用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A. File cache** | `bw-update-completion` (`95_bitwarden.zsh`) | 手動 refresh | `eval`-able 完成腳本 |
| **B. `~/.zfunc/_<tool>` + version grep** | sesh / television / worktrunk | 每次 startup grep version string | autoload function |

P1–P3 都屬於 Pattern A。為了減少維護成本,我**在 Pattern A 上加一個 binary mtime check** (`[ "$_bin" -nt "$_cache" ]`),這樣:
- 99% 的 case 自動失效(`mise install ruby@3.5`、`brew upgrade thefuck`、`uv tool upgrade marimo` 都會 bump binary mtime)
- 邊角 case(gem-only 升級、cache 寫入時被中斷)用手動 `<tool>-update-completion` helper

**Cache path 慣例**(沿用 bw):
- 跨 shell: `${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/{zsh,bash}/<tool>_completion.{zsh,bash}` (兩 shell 各一份,因為 `_TOOL_COMPLETE=zsh_source` 與 `_TOOL_COMPLETE=bash_source` 輸出不同)
- zsh-only (try): `${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/zsh/try_init.zsh`

## Changes

### P1 — marimo cache (dot_config/shell/29_marimo.sh)

完整重寫(13 行 → ~25 行):

\```sh
# 29_marimo.sh - marimo shell completion (cached, shared by zsh/bash)
# Run `marimo-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade edge cases
# (e.g. uv tool upgrade where the binary mtime check below misses).

command -v marimo >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/marimo_completion.zsh"
    _marimo_shell=zsh
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/marimo_completion.bash"
    _marimo_shell=bash
else
    return 0
fi

_marimo_bin="$(command -v marimo)"
if [ ! -f "$_marimo_cache" ] || [ "$_marimo_bin" -nt "$_marimo_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_marimo_cache")"
    _MARIMO_COMPLETE="${_marimo_shell}_source" marimo > "$_marimo_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_marimo_cache" ] && . "$_marimo_cache"
unset _marimo_cache _marimo_shell _marimo_bin
\```

**Saving**: 282ms (cache miss 仍付 282ms,但只在 `marimo` 升級後第一次 startup 發生)

### P2 — thefuck cache (dot_config/shell/27_thefuck.sh)

同 P1 模式:

\```sh

# Run `thefuck-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade.

command -v thefuck >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _tf_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/thefuck_alias.zsh"
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _tf_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/thefuck_alias.bash"
else
    return 0
fi

_tf_bin="$(command -v thefuck)"
if [ ! -f "$_tf_cache" ] || [ "$_tf_bin" -nt "$_tf_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_tf_cache")"
    thefuck --alias > "$_tf_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_tf_cache" ] && . "$_tf_cache"
unset _tf_cache _tf_bin
\```

**Saving**: 59ms

### P3 — try cache (dot_config/zsh/tools/32_try.zsh)

只動 line 11–16(中段),保留 line 1–9 (env vars) 和 line 18–37 (try-sesh helper):

\```zsh
# Cached gem-path lookup + try init output. Both ruby calls (~67ms) collapse
# to one stat. Run `try-update-completion` to force-refresh after gem upgrade.
_try_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/try_init.zsh"
_try_ruby="$(command -v ruby 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "$_try_ruby" ] && { [ ! -f "$_try_cache" ] || [ "$_try_ruby" -nt "$_try_cache" ]; }; then
    _try_script=$(ruby -e "require 'rubygems'; puts File.join(Gem::Specification.find_by_name('try-cli').gem_dir, 'try.rb')" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -f "$_try_script" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${_try_cache:h}"
        ruby "$_try_script" init > "$_try_cache" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    unset _try_script
fi
[ -s "$_try_cache" ] && source "$_try_cache"
unset _try_cache _try_ruby
\```

**注意**:這裡用 `${_try_cache:h}` (zsh modifier) 而不是 `dirname`,因為這個檔案是 `.zsh` 已是 zsh-only — 與 bw 一致。

**Saving**: 68ms

### P4 — brew shellenv 去重 (dot_config/shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl)

刪除 macOS 那一支(lines 58-64),保留 Linux 分支(lines 65-77)— 因為:
- mac:`dot_zshrc.tmpl:92-98` 與 `dot_bashrc.tmpl:67-71` 都已在 modular layer **之前** 跑過 brew shellenv(`dot_bashrc.tmpl:65-66` 的 comment 明說 "must run before shared layer so bash-completion v2's $HOMEBREW_PREFIX detection works")
- linux:zshrc/bashrc 都沒有 linuxbrew shellenv → 必須由 `00_exports.sh` 提供

Diff 概念:

\```tmpl
- {{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" -}}
- # macOS: Initialize Homebrew (Apple Silicon or Intel)
- if [[ -f /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]]; then
-     eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
- elif [[ -f /usr/local/bin/brew ]]; then
-     eval "$(/usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"
- fi
- {{ else -}}
+ # macOS Homebrew shellenv runs in dot_zshrc.tmpl / dot_bashrc.tmpl BEFORE this
+ # modular layer loads, so bash-completion v2 can see $HOMEBREW_PREFIX. We do
+ # NOT duplicate it here — that would re-run shellenv (~17ms) at no benefit.
+ {{ if eq .chezmoi.os "linux" -}}

  ...(unchanged)
  {{ end -}}
\```

**Saving**: ~17ms × 2 shells = ~34ms (mac only;Linux 沒影響)

### P6 — 新增三個 refresh helpers

#### `dot_config/shell/10_aliases.sh` — 加在 `bw-update-completion` (line 79) 之後:

\```sh
# --- marimo / thefuck completion regen ----------------------------------------
# Same caching strategy as bw-update-completion (above). Mtime check on the
# binary catches `uv tool upgrade marimo` / `brew upgrade thefuck` automatically;
# these helpers exist for edge cases (in-place upgrade where mtime doesn't bump,
# corrupted cache, manual debugging).
function marimo-update-completion {
    command -v marimo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "marimo not installed" >&2; return 1; }
    if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh" &&
            _MARIMO_COMPLETE=zsh_source marimo >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/marimo_completion.zsh" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "marimo completion cache updated (zsh)"
    elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash" &&
            _MARIMO_COMPLETE=bash_source marimo >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/marimo_completion.bash" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "marimo completion cache updated (bash)"
    fi
}

function thefuck-update-completion {
    command -v thefuck >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "thefuck not installed" >&2; return 1; }
    if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh" &&
            thefuck --alias >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/thefuck_alias.zsh" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "thefuck alias cache updated (zsh)"
    elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash" &&
            thefuck --alias >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/thefuck_alias.bash" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "thefuck alias cache updated (bash)"
    fi
}
\```

**重要**:用 `function name { … }` 語法而不是 POSIX `name() { … }` — 遵守 `pitfalls/zsh-parse-error-on-resource-after-bw-completion-aliased-name.md` 的教訓(避免被自身輸出的 alias 蓋掉導致 re-source 解析失敗)。

#### `dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh` — 加 try helper (zsh-only):

\```zsh
# Force-refresh try-cli init cache (zsh-only). Mtime check on `ruby` binary
# auto-invalidates on mise version switch; run this manually after a gem-only
# upgrade (gem update try-cli) or if the cache file got corrupted.
function try-update-completion {
    command -v ruby >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ruby not installed" >&2; return 1; }
    local _script
    _script=$(ruby -e "require 'rubygems'; puts File.join(Gem::Specification.find_by_name('try-cli').gem_dir, 'try.rb')" 2>/dev/null)
    [[ -f "$_script" ]] || { echo "try-cli gem not found" >&2; return 1; }
    local _cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/try_init.zsh"
    mkdir -p "${_cache:h}"
    ruby "$_script" init >"$_cache" 2>/dev/null &&
        echo "try-cli init cache updated"
}
\```

### P7 — Cross-file maintenance updates (per CLAUDE.md)

- **`docs/shells/aliases.md`**: 加 3 列(marimo-update-completion / thefuck-update-completion / try-update-completion),格式對齊既有 bw-update-completion 列。
- **`docs/zsh/zsh-completions.md`**: 在 Section C "Eval/source at startup" 段註明 marimo / thefuck / try 已升級為 cached(指向 P6 的 update helpers)。
- **`pitfalls/`**: 不開新檔(目前沒踩坑)。如果未來 cache invalidation 出問題再寫。

## Defect / Regression 分析

| 風險 | 機率 | 影響 | 緩解 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cache miss 仍付全價** | 100% (第一次 / upgrade 後) | startup 慢 ~280–390ms 一次 | 接受 — 攤提下來幾乎無感;不是優化目標 |
| **Binary mtime 沒 bump 的升級** | 低(uv tool / brew 升級會 bump) | 完成過時(顯示舊 subcommand) | 手動 `<tool>-update-completion` |
| **Cache 寫入被中斷(kill -9 中途)** | 極低 | `eval` 部分內容,可能語法錯誤 | `[ -s ]` 檢查非空;若仍出錯可手動 rm cache 觸發重生。**未加 atomic mktemp+mv** — 既有 bw 模式也沒加,維持一致性,複雜度收益不對等 |
| **多 shell 同時啟動 race condition** | 中(開新 tmux 視窗常觸發) | 兩個 `> cache` 互相 truncate,可能寫一半 | 同上 — 既有 bw 也有此問題,實務上沒人回報 |
| **`-nt` POSIX 兼容性** | 0% (bash + zsh 都支援) | — | 已在 `99_chezmoi_reload.sh` 用過 |
| **`try init` 輸出 bake env vars** | 未驗證 | 若 `TRY_PATH` 改變但 cache 未刷新 → wrong path | **必驗證**:`cat $XDG_CACHE_HOME/zsh/try_init.zsh` 看是否含字面值的 `TRY_PATH=…`;若有,在 cache 上方加 `export TRY_PATH=…` 重 export 或記到 pitfalls/。 |
| **brew shellenv 去重後 mac 缺 PATH** | 0% | — | mac 的 zshrc/bashrc 已在 modular layer 前跑 brew shellenv;`00_exports.sh` 跑時 PATH 已含 brew |
| **brew shellenv 去重影響 Linux** | 0% | — | Linux 分支保留;zshrc/bashrc 沒 linuxbrew 區塊 |
| **chezmoi-apply reload hint 不知道 cache 該失效** | 低 | 用戶在 chezmoi 改 `29_marimo.sh` 後,cache 還是舊內容 | 不影響 — cache 內容是 marimo binary 輸出的,跟 `29_marimo.sh` 內容無關;binary mtime check 才是關鍵 |
| **舊 zcompdump 刪錯 active 的** | 低 | 下次 startup 自動重建,慢 ~30ms 一次 | 只刪 smart-quote hostname 那幾份,active 是 `Da-Weis-Mac-mini-5.9` 不會中招 |
| **Helper function 被自己產生的 alias 蓋掉(zsh re-source)** | 已知 (見 pitfalls/) | re-source `~/.zshrc` parse error | 用 `function name { … }` 語法繞過 alias expansion |
| **bash `~/.cache/bash/` 目錄沒被既有清理機制掃** | 低 | 目錄殘留 stale completion | bw 已在用 `~/.cache/bash/`,無新增風險 |

## 不做的事

- **不**改 `~/.zshrc` brew shellenv 與 oh-my-zsh load 順序(目前順序確實會讓 brew 提供的 `/opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions` 沒進 compinit fpath,但這是另一個獨立議題,不在這次優化範圍)
- **不**碰 oh-my-zsh 本身的 552ms(plugin load 不在這次目標,要動就是換掉 OMZ)
- **不**為 marimo/thefuck/try 加 atomic write(mktemp+mv)— 與 bw 既有風格保持一致
- **不**新增 cache invalidation script 到 `.chezmoiscripts/`(binary mtime check 已涵蓋 99% case)

## Approved Plan:
# zsh Startup Optimization — Cache slow completions + dedup brew shellenv

## Context

Steady-state zsh startup is currently **~700ms**;cold start ~2.5s。前一輪 profiling (`ZSH_PROF=1 zsh` + 自訂 per-file timing) 已找出 5 個明確瓶頸:

| # | 來源 | 時間 | 主因 |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | `dot_config/shell/29_marimo.sh:9-13` | **282ms** | 每次 startup 跑 `_MARIMO_COMPLETE=zsh_source marimo` (Python cold start ~520ms 的子進程) |
| P2 | `dot_config/zsh/tools/32_try.zsh:12,15` | **68ms** | 每次跑 ruby ×2(找 gem dir + `try init`) |
| P3 | `dot_config/shell/27_thefuck.sh:9` | **59ms** | 每次跑 `thefuck --alias` Python 子進程 |
| P4 | `dot_config/shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl:58-64` 與 `dot_zshrc.tmpl:92-98` / `dot_bashrc.tmpl:67-71` | **~17ms ×2 shells** | brew shellenv 在 mac 上跑兩次(zsh 與 bash 都中招) |
| P5 | `~/.zcompdump-Da-Wei's Mac mini-5.9*` 5 份舊 dump | 0ms (cosmetic) | hostname 改過後留下的孤兒檔 |

**目標**:把 P1–P4 共 ~448ms 砍掉,steady-state 從 ~700ms 降到 **~250ms** (約 -64%)。

**為何用 cache 而不是 lazy-init / 移除工具**:
- marimo / thefuck / try 都還在用,使用者沒打算停用 → 不能像 nvm 那樣延遲到 `LOAD_NVM=1`
- 完成腳本只是 `eval`-able 文字,適合 file cache(對比 `_<tool>` autoload function 適合 `~/.zfunc/`)
- 既有 canonical pattern 已存在(Bitwarden, `dot_config/zsh/tools/95_bitwarden.zsh:11-17`)— 直接 mirror,不要發明新 abstraction

## Strategy: Mirror Bitwarden 的 cache 模式 + 加 mtime 失效

既有的兩種 caching pattern:

| Pattern | 例子 | 失效機制 | 適用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A. File cache** | `bw-update-completion` (`95_bitwarden.zsh`) | 手動 refresh | `eval`-able 完成腳本 |
| **B. `~/.zfunc/_<tool>` + version grep** | sesh / television / worktrunk | 每次 startup grep version string | autoload function |

P1–P3 都屬於 Pattern A。為了減少維護成本,我**在 Pattern A 上加一個 binary mtime check** (`[ "$_bin" -nt "$_cache" ]`),這樣:
- 99% 的 case 自動失效(`mise install ruby@3.5`、`brew upgrade thefuck`、`uv tool upgrade marimo` 都會 bump binary mtime)
- 邊角 case(gem-only 升級、cache 寫入時被中斷)用手動 `<tool>-update-completion` helper

**Cache path 慣例**(沿用 bw):
- 跨 shell: `${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/{zsh,bash}/<tool>_completion.{zsh,bash}` (兩 shell 各一份,因為 `_TOOL_COMPLETE=zsh_source` 與 `_TOOL_COMPLETE=bash_source` 輸出不同)
- zsh-only (try): `${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/zsh/try_init.zsh`

## Changes

### P1 — marimo cache (dot_config/shell/29_marimo.sh)

完整重寫(13 行 → ~25 行):

```sh
# 29_marimo.sh - marimo shell completion (cached, shared by zsh/bash)
# Run `marimo-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade edge cases
# (e.g. uv tool upgrade where the binary mtime check below misses).

command -v marimo >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/marimo_completion.zsh"
    _marimo_shell=zsh
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/marimo_completion.bash"
    _marimo_shell=bash
else
    return 0
fi

_marimo_bin="$(command -v marimo)"
if [ ! -f "$_marimo_cache" ] || [ "$_marimo_bin" -nt "$_marimo_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_marimo_cache")"
    _MARIMO_COMPLETE="${_marimo_shell}_source" marimo > "$_marimo_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_marimo_cache" ] && . "$_marimo_cache"
unset _marimo_cache _marimo_shell _marimo_bin
```

**Saving**: 282ms (cache miss 仍付 282ms,但只在 `marimo` 升級後第一次 startup 發生)

### P2 — thefuck cache (dot_config/shell/27_thefuck.sh)

同 P1 模式:

```sh
# 27_thefuck.sh - thefuck alias (cached, shared by zsh/bash).
# Run `thefuck-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade.

command -v thefuck >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _tf_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/thefuck_alias.zsh"
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _tf_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/thefuck_alias.bash"
else
    return 0
fi

_tf_bin="$(command -v thefuck)"
if [ ! -f "$_tf_cache" ] || [ "$_tf_bin" -nt "$_tf_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_tf_cache")"
    thefuck --alias > "$_tf_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_tf_cache" ] && . "$_tf_cache"
unset _tf_cache _tf_bin
```

**Saving**: 59ms

### P3 — try cache (dot_config/zsh/tools/32_try.zsh)

只動 line 11–16(中段),保留 line 1–9 (env vars) 和 line 18–37 (try-sesh helper):

```zsh
# Cached gem-path lookup + try init output. Both ruby calls (~67ms) collapse
# to one stat. Run `try-update-completion` to force-refresh after gem upgrade.
_try_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/try_init.zsh"
_try_ruby="$(command -v ruby 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "$_try_ruby" ] && { [ ! -f "$_try_cache" ] || [ "$_try_ruby" -nt "$_try_cache" ]; }; then
    _try_script=$(ruby -e "require 'rubygems'; puts File.join(Gem::Specification.find_by_name('try-cli').gem_dir, 'try.rb')" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -f "$_try_script" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${_try_cache:h}"
        ruby "$_try_script" init > "$_try_cache" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    unset _try_script
fi
[ -s "$_try_cache" ] && source "$_try_cache"
unset _try_cache _try_ruby
```

**注意**:這裡用 `${_try_cache:h}` (zsh modifier) 而不是 `dirname`,因為這個檔案是 `.zsh` 已是 zsh-only — 與 bw 一致。

**Saving**: 68ms

### P4 — brew shellenv 去重 (dot_config/shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl)

Diff 概念:

```tmpl
- {{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" -}}
- # macOS: Initialize Homebrew (Apple Silicon or Intel)
- if [[ -f /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]]; then
-     eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
- elif [[ -f /usr/local/bin/brew ]]; then

- fi
- {{ else -}}
+ # macOS Homebrew shellenv runs in dot_zshrc.tmpl / dot_bashrc.tmpl BEFORE this

+ # NOT duplicate it here — that would re-run shellenv (~17ms) at no benefit.
+ {{ if eq .chezmoi.os "linux" -}}

  ...(unchanged)

```

**Saving**: ~17ms × 2 shells = ~34ms (mac only;Linux 沒影響)

### P6 — 新增三個 refresh helpers

#### `dot_config/shell/10_aliases.sh` — 加在 `bw-update-completion` (line 79) 之後:

```sh
# --- marimo / thefuck completion regen ----------------------------------------
# Same caching strategy as bw-update-completion (above). Mtime check on the
# binary catches `uv tool upgrade marimo` / `brew upgrade thefuck` automatically;
# these helpers exist for edge cases (in-place upgrade where mtime doesn't bump,
# corrupted cache, manual debugging).
function marimo-update-completion {
    command -v marimo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "marimo not installed" >&2; return 1; }
    if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh" &&
            _MARIMO_COMPLETE=zsh_source marimo >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/marimo_completion.zsh" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "marimo completion cache updated (zsh)"
    elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash" &&
            _MARIMO_COMPLETE=bash_source marimo >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/marimo_completion.bash" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "marimo completion cache updated (bash)"
    fi
}

function thefuck-update-completion {
    command -v thefuck >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "thefuck not installed" >&2; return 1; }
    if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh" &&
            thefuck --alias >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/thefuck_alias.zsh" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "thefuck alias cache updated (zsh)"
    elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
        mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash" &&
            thefuck --alias >"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/thefuck_alias.bash" 2>/dev/null &&
            echo "thefuck alias cache updated (bash)"
    fi
}
```

**重要**:用 `function name { … }` 語法而不是 POSIX `name() { … }` — 遵守 `pitfalls/zsh-parse-error-on-resource-after-bw-completion-aliased-name.md` 的教訓(避免被自身輸出的 alias 蓋掉導致 re-source 解析失敗)。

#### `dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh` — 加 try helper (zsh-only):

```zsh
# Force-refresh try-cli init cache (zsh-only). Mtime check on `ruby` binary
# auto-invalidates on mise version switch; run this manually after a gem-only
# upgrade (gem update try-cli) or if the cache file got corrupted.
function try-update-completion {
    command -v ruby >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ruby not installed" >&2; return 1; }
    local _script
    _script=$(ruby -e "require 'rubygems'; puts File.join(Gem::Specification.find_by_name('try-cli').gem_dir, 'try.rb')" 2>/dev/null)
    [[ -f "$_script" ]] || { echo "try-cli gem not found" >&2; return 1; }
    local _cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/try_init.zsh"
    mkdir -p "${_cache:h}"
    ruby "$_script" init >"$_cache" 2>/dev/null &&
        echo "try-cli init cache updated"
}
```

### P7 — Cross-file maintenance updates (per CLAUDE.md)

- **`docs/shells/aliases.md`**: 加 3 列(marimo-update-completion / thefuck-update-completion / try-update-completion),格式對齊既有 bw-update-completion 列。
- **`docs/zsh/zsh-completions.md`**: 在 Section C "Eval/source at startup" 段註明 marimo / thefuck / try 已升級為 cached(指向 P6 的 update helpers)。
- **`pitfalls/`**: 不開新檔(目前沒踩坑)。如果未來 cache invalidation 出問題再寫。

## Defect / Regression 分析

| 風險 | 機率 | 影響 | 緩解 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cache miss 仍付全價** | 100% (第一次 / upgrade 後) | startup 慢 ~280–390ms 一次 | 接受 — 攤提下來幾乎無感;不是優化目標 |
| **Binary mtime 沒 bump 的升級** | 低(uv tool / brew 升級會 bump) | 完成過時(顯示舊 subcommand) | 手動 `<tool>-update-completion` |
| **Cache 寫入被中斷(kill -9 中途)** | 極低 | `eval` 部分內容,可能語法錯誤 | `[ -s ]` 檢查非空;若仍出錯可手動 rm cache 觸發重生。**未加 atomic mktemp+mv** — 既有 bw 模式也沒加,維持一致性,複雜度收益不對等 |
| **多 shell 同時啟動 race condition** | 中(開新 tmux 視窗常觸發) | 兩個 `> cache` 互相 truncate,可能寫一半 | 同上 — 既有 bw 也有此問題,實務上沒人回報 |
| **`-nt` POSIX 兼容性** | 0% (bash + zsh 都支援) | — | 已在 `99_chezmoi_reload.sh` 用過 |
| **`try init` 輸出 bake env vars** | 未驗證 | 若 `TRY_PATH` 改變但 cache 未刷新 → wrong path | **必驗證**:`cat $XDG_CACHE_HOME/zsh/try_init.zsh` 看是否含字面值的 `TRY_PATH=…`;若有,在 cache 上方加 `export TRY_PATH=…` 重 export 或記到 pitfalls/。 |
| **brew shellenv 去重後 mac 缺 PATH** | 0% | — | mac 的 zshrc/bashrc 已在 modular layer 前跑 brew shellenv;`00_exports.sh` 跑時 PATH 已含 brew |
| **brew shellenv 去重影響 Linux** | 0% | — | Linux 分支保留;zshrc/bashrc 沒 linuxbrew 區塊 |
| **chezmoi-apply reload hint 不知道 cache 該失效** | 低 | 用戶在 chezmoi 改 `29_marimo.sh` 後,cache 還是舊內容 | 不影響 — cache 內容是 marimo binary 輸出的,跟 `29_marimo.sh` 內容無關;binary mtime check 才是關鍵 |
| **舊 zcompdump 刪錯 active 的** | 低 | 下次 startup 自動重建,慢 ~30ms 一次 | 只刪 smart-quote hostname 那幾份,active 是 `Da-Weis-Mac-mini-5.9` 不會中招 |
| **Helper function 被自己產生的 alias 蓋掉(zsh re-source)** | 已知 (見 pitfalls/) | re-source `~/.zshrc` parse error | 用 `function name { … }` 語法繞過 alias expansion |
| **bash `~/.cache/bash/` 目錄沒被既有清理機制掃** | 低 | 目錄殘留 stale completion | bw 已在用 `~/.cache/bash/`,無新增風險 |

## 不做的事

- **不**改 `~/.zshrc` brew shellenv 與 oh-my-zsh load 順序(目前順序確實會讓 brew 提供的 `/opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions` 沒進 compinit fpath,但這是另一個獨立議題,不在這次優化範圍)

1	# Custom Aliases & Shell Functions
2	
3	Quick reference for custom aliases and shell functions defined in this dotfiles repo. Available in zsh, bash, or both — the source file path tells you which:
4	
5	- `dot_config/shell/*.sh` — POSIX layer, sourced by **both** `~/.zshrc` and `~/.bashrc`.
6	- `dot_config/zsh/*.zsh` (or `tools/*.zsh`) — **zsh-only**.
7	- `dot_config/bash/*.bash` — **bash-only**.
8	
9	> **Maintenance rule** (mirrored in `CLAUDE.md`): whenever you add, modify, or remove a custom alias or shell function in `dot_config/{shell,zsh,bash}/`, update this table — include the type (`alias` or `function`), source file (relative to repo root), and a one-line description. Place new helpers in the right tier per the [CLAUDE.md three-tier rule](../../CLAUDE.md#custom-aliases--shell-functions--docsshellsaliasesmd).

453	
454	## Session Management
455	
456	> `sesh-*` requires `sesh` + `tmux`; `tsesh` also requires the `try-cli` Ruby gem. `mrun` / `tmrun` / `zjrun` only need tmux or zellij (whichever backend is selected) — no sesh dependency.

546	### Proxy helpers
547	
548	> Portable loopback-proxy helpers. Honors `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` (+ optional `$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL` for split Clash `socks-port:` configs); otherwise prefers an active Clash config (`mixed-port:` or `port:`/`socks-port:` from `~/.config/clash/config.yaml` or `~/Library/Application Support/clash/config.yaml`) before falling back to probing ports 7890/7891/1087/8118/8080 with `nc -z -w1`. Detection is cached per shell; `proxy-off` and `proxy-refresh` clear that cache before the next lookup. Set `$LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE=1` to auto-export env vars on shell startup. Full guide: [docs/tools/web-reader.md](../tools/web-reader.md). See also: [docs/tools/containers.md](../tools/containers.md) for how `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` feeds the chezmoi-managed `~/.docker/config.json` `proxies.default` block.
549	
550	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |
551	|---------|------|-------------|-------------|
552	| `withproxy` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Run a single command with proxy env vars exported to the child only (e.g. `withproxy curl ...`) |
553	| `try_direct_then_proxy` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Run a command direct; on failure, retry via `withproxy`. Used as the default for reader functions. |
554	| `proxy-on` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Export `http_proxy`/`https_proxy`/`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY` in the current shell |
555	| `proxy-off` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Unset all proxy env vars in the current shell |
556	| `proxy-status` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Report state: **active** (exported), **available** (detected), or **unavailable** |
557	| `proxy-test` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Test detected proxy egress with `curl https://www.google.com/generate_204` (HTTP, not ICMP ping) |
558	| `proxy-refresh` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Clear cached detection, re-probe, print status (use after toggling your proxy) |

625	
626	## macOS apps
627	
628	> Graceful GUI app control via `osascript` + Apple Events. Prefer over `killall` for apps with state (OrbStack, Docker Desktop, Slack, etc.) — `quit` sends ⌘Q-equivalent, letting the app tear down cleanly. App NAME is the AppleScript name (e.g. `OrbStack`, `Google Chrome`), not bundle ID; passed via `osascript argv` so spaces/quotes are safe.
629	
630	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |
631	|---------|------|-------------|-------------|
632	| `appquit <AppName>` | function | `dot_config/shell/54_macos_apps.sh.tmpl` (macOS), `dot_config/shell/56_linux_apps.sh.tmpl` (Linux) | **Cross-platform.** macOS: Quit Apple Event (graceful, equivalent to ⌘Q). Linux: `pkill -TERM -f <pattern>` resolved from `~/.config/shell/linux-apps.conf` overrides or auto-derived from `.desktop` scan; Electron + Firefox honour SIGTERM as graceful quit. |
633	| `applaunch <AppName>` | function | same as above | **Cross-platform.** macOS: launch in background (no focus steal). Linux: `gtk-launch <desktop-id>` via `setsid -f`. App-defined startup behaviour applies. |
634	| `appactivate <AppName>` | function | same as above | **Cross-platform.** macOS: launch + bring to front. Linux: D-Bus call to GNOME `window-calls` extension if installed (best fidelity), otherwise falls back to `applaunch` (single-instance apps re-focus). |
635	| `apprestart <AppName>` | function | same as above | **Cross-platform.** `appquit` + poll until process gone (≤15s) + `applaunch`. On Linux, launches the app even if it wasn't running (mirrors macOS silent-quit semantics). |
636	| `apprunning <AppName>` | function | same as above | **Cross-platform.** Silent predicate; exit 0 if running, 1 otherwise. Linux backend: `pgrep -f <pattern>`. |
637	| `applist [--pids\|--all]` | function | same as above | **Cross-platform.** Default: names of running apps the helper recognises. `--pids` adds `<pid>\t<name>` (used by `tv {mac,linux}-apps`). macOS lists foreground GUI apps via System Events; Linux enumerates registered overrides + auto-derived from `.desktop` scan filtered to running processes. Linux `--all` shows non-running entries too. |
638	| `appresponsive <AppName> [TIMEOUT_SEC]` | function | same as above | **Cross-platform, divergent fidelity.** macOS: best-effort "Not Responding" via timed-out Apple Event. Linux: only meaningful for apps registered with `--mpris=NAME` (Spotify, mpv, VLC); for Electron/Firefox/most apps it degrades to `apprunning` with a stderr note — no public Linux API analog to macOS Apple Events. |
639	| `linux_app_register NAME [OPTS]` | function | `dot_config/shell/56_linux_apps.sh.tmpl` | **Linux-only.** Register an app for the Linux `app-*` helpers — `--desktop=ID --pkill=REGEX --wm-class=CLASS [--mpris=NAME]`. Typical call site: `~/.config/shell/linux-apps.conf` (sourced at shell startup, never auto-stubbed). Override file matters for AppImage / Snap / Flatpak where auto-derivation can't resolve the runtime binary path — see `pitfalls/linux-app-control-appimage-runtime-path.md`. `linux_app_register --list` prints the current registry. |

681	## Tmux Integration
682	
683	> Requires tmux + OSC 133 markers in the pane's scrollback (emitted by [`02_shell_integration.zsh`](../../dot_config/zsh/tools/02_shell_integration.zsh) — if missing, run `exec zsh` to reload). All three functions print to stdout (pipe-friendly: `cpout | grep ERROR`) AND copy to the system clipboard via tmux's OSC 52 bridge. Shell-level counterparts of the `prefix + M-y` / `M-i` tmux bindings — see [docs/tools/tmux/README.md → OSC 133](../tools/tmux/README.md#osc-133-command-boundary-navigation-warp-style).

689	| `cpblock [N]` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/03_tmux_capture.zsh` | Print + copy the **Nth-latest command's full block** (prompt + input + output). Default N=1 |
690	| `tsum [-d\|--shallow] [-r] [-i] [--sort closability] [--only TIER] [--dry-run]` | function | `dot_config/shell/61_tmux_summary.sh` | AI-summarize every tmux session — one-glance "what is this session", with closability tiers (🟢 safe / 🟡 check / 🔴 keep). Reuses the AI Capture agent fallback (claude / opencode / codex / cursor-agent); 10-min cached in `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/tmux-session-summary/`. `-d` includes the visible area of each session's active pane (20-100 lines, self-capture skipped); set `TSUM_DEEP_DEFAULT=1` in `~/.shellrc.adhoc` to make `-d` implicit (override with `--shallow`). `--sort closability` orders keep → check → safe (default: alphabetical); `--only {safe,check,keep}` filters to one tier. `-r` bypasses cache; `-i` opens fzf picker that switches client on Enter (also reachable via tmux `prefix + Space → Sessions → AI session summary`); `--dry-run` prints the prompt without calling the LLM. **On hosts with multiple tmux binaries** (apt + appimage, brew + system) export `TSUM_TMUX_BIN=/path/to/tmux` so tsum talks to the right server. |

695	
696	> One-shot pipeline: capture a past block (via `cpblock N`) and pass it to a coding-agent CLI (claude / opencode / codex / cursor-agent) in non-interactive / advisory mode. Agent auto-detected in the order listed; override with `-a AGENT`. Prompt override via `-p PROMPT`. Agent reply goes to stdout (pipe-friendly: `aifix | tee /tmp/advice.md`), status line to stderr.

```text
1	# Zsh Completions Best Practices
2	
3	How zsh tab completions are organized in this dotfiles project.
4	
5	## Architecture
6	
7	```
8	compinit runs once (inside oh-my-zsh.sh)
9	        │
10	        ├── ~/.zfunc/                          ← user-generated completions (NOT tracked by chezmoi)
11	        ├── ~/.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/       ← community completions (184 files, cloned by ansible)
12	        │     └── zsh-completions/src/
13	        ├── ~/.docker/completions/             ← Docker-shipped completions
14	        ├── $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/        ← Homebrew-managed completions (via `brew completions link`)
15	        │     └── site-functions/
16	        └── $ZSH/completions/                  ← oh-my-zsh built-in completions
17	```
18	
19	All `fpath` additions are in `dot_zshrc.tmpl` **before** `source "$ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh"`, so `compinit` runs exactly once and picks up everything.
20	
21	## Completion Categories
22	
23	Tools fall into four categories:
24	
25	### A. Self-generating (`tool completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_tool`)
26	
27	Most modern CLI tools can output their own completion script. Run once after install, re-run after version upgrades.
28	
29	| Tool | Command |
30	|------|---------|
31	| `uv` | `uv generate-shell-completion zsh` |
32	| `mise` | `mise completion zsh` |
33	| `chezmoi` | `chezmoi completion zsh` |
34	| `just` | `just --completions zsh` |
35	| `bat` | `bat --completion zsh` |
36	| `delta` | `delta --generate-completion zsh` |
37	| `starship` | `starship completions zsh` |
38	| `rg` | `rg --generate complete-zsh` |
39	| `fd` | `fd --gen-completions zsh` |
40	| `zellij` | `zellij setup --generate-completion zsh` |
41	| `sesh` | `sesh completion zsh` |
42	| `pueue` | `pueue completions zsh` |
43	| `docker` | `docker completion zsh` |
44	| `gh` | `gh completion -s zsh` |
45	| `opencode` | `opencode completion zsh` |
46	| `bw` | `bw completion --shell zsh` |
47	
48	**Usage pattern:**
49	
50	```bash
51	# Generate once (or after upgrade)
52	mkdir -p ~/.zfunc
53	uv generate-shell-completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_uv
54	mise completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_mise
55	```
56	
57	### B. Pre-bundled (no action needed)
58	
59	Completions ship with the package or via the `zsh-completions` community plugin.
60	
61	| Tool | Source |
62	|------|--------|
63	| `eza` | Homebrew formula installs `_eza` into site-functions |
64	| `git` | oh-my-zsh `git` plugin |
65	| `yazi` | Ships `_yazi` in release assets (also in zsh-completions) |
66	| `lazygit` | No completion support; not needed (TUI app) |
67	| `btop` | No completion support; not needed (TUI app) |
68	| Many others | `zsh-completions` plugin covers 184 tools |
69	
70	### C. Eval/source at startup (shell integration)
71	
72	These tools inject completions as part of broader shell integration. Already handled in `dot_config/zsh/tools/`.
73	
74	| Tool | Where | How |
75	|------|-------|-----|
76	| `fzf` | `tools/10_fzf.zsh` | `source <(fzf --zsh)` |
77	| `zoxide` | `tools/20_zoxide.zsh` | `eval "$(zoxide init zsh)"` |
78	| `thefuck` | `tools/25_thefuck.zsh` | `eval $(thefuck --alias)` |
79	| `direnv` | `tools/30_direnv.zsh` | `eval "$(direnv hook zsh)"` |
80	| `marimo` | `tools/29_marimo.zsh` | `eval "$(_MARIMO_COMPLETE=zsh_source marimo)"` |
81	
82	### D. No completion support
83	
84	`claude`, `gemini`, `btop`, `lazygit` -- no generation command available.
85	
86	### E. Python tools via `shtab` / `tyro`
87	
88	Python CLI frameworks can generate completions:
89	
90	- **[tyro](https://brentyi.github.io/tyro/tab_completion/)**: `python my_cli.py --tyro-write-completion zsh ~/.zfunc/_my_cli`
91	- **[shtab](https://github.com/iterative/shtab)**: `shtab --shell=zsh my_module.parser > ~/.zfunc/_my_tool`
92	- **argcomplete**: `register-python-argcomplete tool_name` (uses eval, category C)
93	- **click** (used by mlflow, litellm, etc.): `_TOOL_COMPLETE=zsh_source tool > ~/.zfunc/_tool`
94	
95	## Why `~/.zfunc/` is NOT Tracked by Chezmoi
96	
97	**Decision: `~/.zfunc/` is not version-controlled.** Rationale:
98	
99	1. **Completions are tool-version-dependent.** A completion script generated by `uv 0.6` may not match `uv 0.7`. Tracking stale files causes subtle breakage.
100	2. **Not all users install the same tools.** A `_pueue` completion file is useless (and throws warnings) if pueue isn't installed.
101	3. **Regeneration is trivial.** One command per tool.
102	4. **Brew-installed tools auto-manage their completions** via site-functions. Duplicating them in `~/.zfunc/` creates conflicts.
103	
104	### What we DO track
105	
106	- `fpath+=~/.zfunc` in `dot_zshrc.tmpl` (ensures the directory is in the search path)
107	- `zsh-completions` plugin cloned by ansible (community completions)
108	- `~/.docker/completions` fpath entry
109	- Tool-specific `eval`/`source` integrations in `dot_config/zsh/tools/`
110	
111	## Generating Completions After Fresh Install
112	
113	After `chezmoi apply` on a new machine, most completions already work via `zsh-completions` plugin and Homebrew site-functions. For tools you want **richer/newer completions**, generate them into `~/.zfunc/`:
114	
115	```bash
116	mkdir -p ~/.zfunc
117	
118	# Core tools (always installed)
119	chezmoi completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_chezmoi
120	mise completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_mise
121	uv generate-shell-completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_uv
122	just --completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_just
123	starship completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_starship
124	
125	# Dev tools (if installed)
126	command -v gh    && gh completion -s zsh > ~/.zfunc/_gh
127	command -v docker && docker completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_docker
128	command -v rg    && rg --generate complete-zsh > ~/.zfunc/_rg
129	command -v fd    && fd --gen-completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_fd
130	command -v bat   && bat --completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_bat
131	command -v delta && delta --generate-completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_delta
132	command -v zellij && zellij setup --generate-completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_zellij
133	command -v sesh  && sesh completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_sesh
134	command -v pueue && pueue completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_pueue
135	
136	# Coding agents (if installed)
137	command -v opencode && opencode completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_opencode
138	command -v bw    && bw completion --shell zsh > ~/.zfunc/_bw
139	
140	# Force rebuild completion cache
141	rm -f ~/.zcompdump && compinit
142	```
143	
144	> **Tip:** You can save this as a script in `~/.local/bin/` or add it to `~/.zshrc.adhoc` as a function.
145	
146	## Priority / Override Order
147	
148	When the same `_tool` file exists in multiple fpath directories, the **first match wins**:
149	
150	```
151	1. ~/.zfunc/                                    (highest - your overrides)
152	2. ~/.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/zsh-completions/src/
153	3. ~/.docker/completions/
154	4. $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/   (Homebrew-managed)
155	5. /usr/share/zsh/*/functions/                  (system, lowest)
156	```
157	
158	Current `dot_zshrc.tmpl` order:
159	
160	```zsh
161	fpath+=~/.zfunc                     # appended (lowest of custom)
162	fpath=(zsh-completions/src $fpath)  # prepended (higher than ~/.zfunc)
163	fpath=(~/.docker/completions $fpath) # prepended (highest of custom)
164	```
165	
166	If you want `~/.zfunc/` to override community completions, change to prepend:
167	
168	```zsh
169	fpath=(~/.zfunc $fpath)  # prepend instead of append
170	```
171	
172	## FAQ
173	
174	**Q: Should I generate completions for tools that `zsh-completions` already covers?**
175	A: Only if you want the latest version. The community plugin may lag behind. For fast-moving tools (uv, mise), generating your own is worthwhile.
176	
177	**Q: A completion file throws errors after I uninstall a tool. What do I do?**
178	A: Remove the file: `rm ~/.zfunc/_toolname`. Stale `_tool` files in fpath are harmless (silently ignored) unless they have syntax errors.
179	
180	**Q: How do I debug completion issues?**
181	A: Run `echo $fpath | tr ' ' '\n'` to see all fpath entries. Use `which _toolname` to see which completion file is being used. Force rebuild with `rm -f ~/.zcompdump && compinit`.
182
```

# 29_marimo.sh - marimo shell completion (cached; shared by zsh/bash).
# Run `marimo-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade edge cases
# (e.g. `uv tool upgrade marimo` where the binary mtime check below misses).

command -v marimo >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/marimo_completion.zsh"
    _marimo_shell=zsh
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/marimo_completion.bash"
    _marimo_shell=bash
else
    return 0
fi

_marimo_bin="$(command -v marimo)"
if [ ! -f "$_marimo_cache" ] || [ "$_marimo_bin" -nt "$_marimo_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_marimo_cache")"
    _MARIMO_COMPLETE="${_marimo_shell}_source" marimo > "$_marimo_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_marimo_cache" ] && . "$_marimo_cache"
unset _marimo_cache _marimo_shell _marimo_bin

```

# 00_exports.sh - Shell-agnostic environment variables (POSIX subset).
# Sourced by both ~/.zshrc and ~/.bashrc via load_modular_dir
# "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/shell" sh.
# Profile: macos (OS: darwin, arch: arm64)

# Editor
# if [[ -n $SSH_CONNECTION ]]; then
#     export EDITOR='vim'
# else
#     export EDITOR='nvim'
# fi
# Let's always use nvim (but sometimes, when the latency is high,
# some animation might be slow)
export EDITOR='nvim'
export VISUAL="$EDITOR"

# Language
export LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"

# PATH additions
# ~/.dotfiles/bin: chezmoi-managed scripts (this repo's dot_dotfiles/bin/)
# ~/bin: legacy / user-placed binaries (transitional, will be removed once
#        every host has applied the new layout and old ~/bin/* cleaned up)
# ~/.local/bin: auto-installed tools (uv tool, cargo install, mise, npm -g, ...)
export PATH="$HOME/.dotfiles/bin:$HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

# .NET global tools (e.g. azure-cost-cli via `dotnet tool install --global`).
# Default install location per `dotnet-install.sh` and Homebrew's dotnet cask.
# Only prepend if the directory exists, so we don't pollute PATH on hosts
# without .NET installed.
if [[ -d "$HOME/.dotnet/tools" ]]; then
    export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"
fi
# dotnet itself (noRoot Linux install target; macOS/Linux-sudo install to
# system locations already on $PATH).
if [[ -x "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" ]]; then
    export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH"
    export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"
fi

# =============================================================================
# Homebrew Setup
# =============================================================================
# macOS Homebrew shellenv runs in dot_zshrc.tmpl / dot_bashrc.tmpl BEFORE this
# modular layer loads (so bash-completion v2 can see $HOMEBREW_PREFIX). We do
# NOT duplicate it here — that would re-run shellenv (~17ms) at zero benefit.
# Linux has no equivalent block in zshrc/bashrc, so Linuxbrew is initialised here.
# Set default Brewfile location (XDG-compliant)
export HOMEBREW_BUNDLE_FILE="$HOME/.config/homebrew/Brewfile"

# =============================================================================
# GFW Mirrors (useChineseMirror=true) — env-var driven package ecosystems.
# Config-file driven ecosystems (PyPI/uv, npm, Bun, cargo, docker registry)
# live in their own templates under dot_config/ and dot_cargo/.
# =============================================================================

# Homebrew: bottles (ghcr.io default → partial-transfer errors) + brew.git + core.
# Mirrors ordered by typical reliability behind GFW:
#   - Aliyun (ACTIVE): commercial CDN, least queueing
```

# 29_marimo.sh - marimo shell completion (cached; shared by zsh/bash).
# Run `marimo-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade edge cases
# (e.g. `uv tool upgrade marimo` where the binary mtime check below misses).

command -v marimo >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/marimo_completion.zsh"
    _marimo_shell=zsh
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _marimo_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/marimo_completion.bash"
    _marimo_shell=bash
else
    return 0
fi

_marimo_bin="$(command -v marimo)"
if [ ! -f "$_marimo_cache" ] || [ "$_marimo_bin" -nt "$_marimo_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_marimo_cache")"
    _MARIMO_COMPLETE="${_marimo_shell}_source" marimo > "$_marimo_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_marimo_cache" ] && . "$_marimo_cache"
unset _marimo_cache _marimo_shell _marimo_bin
===
# 27_thefuck.sh - auto-correct previous command (cached; shared by zsh/bash).
# Run `thefuck-update-completion` to force-refresh after upgrade.
# https://github.com/nvbn/thefuck

command -v thefuck >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
    _tf_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/thefuck_alias.zsh"
elif [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then
    _tf_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bash/thefuck_alias.bash"
else
    return 0
fi

_tf_bin="$(command -v thefuck)"
if [ ! -f "$_tf_cache" ] || [ "$_tf_bin" -nt "$_tf_cache" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_tf_cache")"
    thefuck --alias > "$_tf_cache" 2>/dev/null
fi
[ -s "$_tf_cache" ] && . "$_tf_cache"
unset _tf_cache _tf_bin

# Optional: Use a different alias (uncomment to enable)
# eval "$(thefuck --alias fk)"
```

```text
# 32_try.zsh - try-cli configuration (ephemeral workspace manager)
# https://github.com/tobi/try

# Preserve user overrides, but default the graduate destination to the
# normalized parent of TRY_PATH so Ctrl-G has a predictable target.
# https://github.com/tobi/try/commit/4bb73376044e1ed8149a66513cec42155bb9f0d3
export TRY_PATH="${TRY_PATH:-$HOME/src/tries}"
export TRY_PATH="${TRY_PATH:A}"
export TRY_PROJECTS="${TRY_PROJECTS:-${TRY_PATH:h}}"

# Cached try-cli init: avoids two ruby cold starts (~67ms) on every shell
# startup. Mtime check on the ruby binary auto-invalidates after a `mise
# install ruby@<NEW>`. After a gem-only upgrade (`gem update try-cli`),
# force-refresh with `try-update-completion`. The gem wrapper itself is
# broken due to a __FILE__ == $0 guard, hence the indirect ruby try.rb call.
_try_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/try_init.zsh"
_try_ruby="$(command -v ruby 2>/dev/null)"
if [[ -n "$_try_ruby" ]] && { [[ ! -f "$_try_cache" ]] || [[ "$_try_ruby" -nt "$_try_cache" ]]; }; then
    _try_script=$(ruby -e "require 'rubygems'; puts File.join(Gem::Specification.find_by_name('try-cli').gem_dir, 'try.rb')" 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ -f "$_try_script" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "${_try_cache:h}"
        ruby "$_try_script" init > "$_try_cache" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    unset _try_script
fi
[[ -s "$_try_cache" ]] || { unset _try_cache _try_ruby; return 0; }
source "$_try_cache"
unset _try_cache _try_ruby

# ── try + sesh integration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Open a try project and immediately start a sesh coding session.
# Usage:
#   try-sesh some-project       # fuzzy-match or create, then sesh connect
#   try-sesh https://github.com/user/repo  # clone, then sesh connect
#
# The session name follows sesh's dir_length=2 convention:
#   e.g. "tries/2026-04-14-some-project"
function try-sesh() {
    if ! command -v sesh &>/dev/null; then
        echo "try-sesh: sesh not found" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    # Run try, which cd's into the project directory
    try "$@" || return $?
    # Now connect sesh to the directory try landed in
    sesh connect "$PWD"
}

alias tsesh='try-sesh'
```
</details></tool-use>

## SECTION B: fleet's Structure (Deep Dive)

### Umbrella Dispatcher

**File**: `/dot_dotfiles/bin/executable_fleet`  
**Lines**: 1-325  
**Mechanism**: Direct Python dispatch, no subprocess wrapping

```python
# Dispatcher at lines 289-320:
def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] in ("-h", "--help", "help"):
        print(USAGE)
        return 0

    sub = sys.argv[1]
    rest = sys.argv[2:]

    src = _source_path()  # locate chezmoi source dir
    if str(src) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(src))

    dispatch = {
        "chezmoi": _dispatch_chezmoi,      # nested router for 6 actions
        "edit": _dispatch_edit,             # open $EDITOR on ~/.config/fleet/machines.toml
        "tmux": _dispatch_tmux,             # → scripts.fleet.tmux
        "info": _dispatch_info,             # → scripts.fleet.info
        "pueue": _dispatch_pueue,           # → scripts.fleet.pueue
        "exec": _dispatch_exec,             # → scripts.fleet.exec
        "hosts": _dispatch_hosts,           # → scripts.fleet.hosts
    }
    fn = dispatch.get(sub)
    if fn is None:
        print(f"fleet: unknown subcommand '{sub}'\n\n{USAGE}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return fn(rest)
```

**Key properties**:
- No `argparse` / `tyro` at the umbrella level — hand-rolled dispatch
- Each dispatch function forwards to submodule's `main()` after rewriting `sys.argv`
- Nested `_dispatch_chezmoi()` routes 6 actions: `apply`, `status`, `diff`, `tail`, `kill`, `compact` (lines 261-286)

### Flag-parsing frameworks in submodules

| Submodule | Framework | Note |
|-----------|-----------|------|
| `scripts/fleet/apply.py:1-55` | **tyro** — `tyro.cli(Args, …)` | Annotation-driven dataclass args |
| `scripts/fleet/tmux.py` | **tyro** | Same pattern |
| `scripts/fleet/info.py` | **tyro** | Same pattern |
| `scripts/fleet/pueue.py` | **tyro** | Same pattern |
| `scripts/fleet/exec.py:34-63` | **argparse** — `ArgumentParser` + `add_argument('command', nargs=REMAINDER)` | Needed because `--` separator + arbitrary argv list (REMAINDER) maps to argparse's native stop-parsing behaviour; tyro doesn't support REMAINDER |
| `scripts/fleet/hosts.py` | **argparse** | Same rationale as exec.py |

## SECTION C: Existing Completion Patterns to Mirror or Avoid

### Three distinct strategies in use

#### Strategy 1: Eval-and-cache (bitwarden model)

**File**: `dot_config/zsh/tools/95_bitwarden.zsh` (lines 1-18)

```zsh
# 95_bitwarden.zsh - Bitwarden CLI zsh completion
command -v bw &>/dev/null || return 0

# Enable Bitwarden zsh completion (cached — bw is a slow Node.js app)
# Run `bw-update-completion` to regenerate after updating bw
_bw_comp_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/bw_completion.zsh"
if [[ ! -f "$_bw_comp_cache" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "${_bw_comp_cache:h}"
    bw completion --shell zsh 2>/dev/null > "$_bw_comp_cache"
fi
[[ -s "$_bw_comp_cache" ]] && source "$_bw_comp_cache"
unset _bw_comp_cache
```

**Pattern**: 
- Generate once into `${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/zsh/`
- Check existence at shell startup
- Source if present
- Manual refresh helper (not shown, but referenced)

#### Strategy 2: Version-check write-to-zfunc (worktrunk/television model)

**File**: `dot_config/zsh/tools/37_worktrunk.zsh` (lines 24-33)

```zsh
if [[ -d ~/.zfunc ]] && [[ ! -f /opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions/_wt ]] \
                    && [[ ! -f /usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions/_wt ]]; then
    local _wt_ver="$(wt --version 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ ! -f ~/.zfunc/_wt ]] || ! grep -q "${_wt_ver}" ~/.zfunc/_wt 2>/dev/null; then
        {
            print -r -- "# Auto-generated by 37_worktrunk.zsh for ${_wt_ver}"
            COMPLETE=zsh wt 2>/dev/null
        } > ~/.zfunc/_wt
    fi
fi
```

**Pattern**:
- Check if native site-functions exist (Homebrew-installed)
- If not, write to `~/.zfunc/` with version marker
- Only regenerate if version changes OR file missing
- No manual refresh needed (auto-detects upgrades)

**File**: `dot_config/zsh/tools/12_television.zsh` (lines 27-32)

```zsh
if [[ -d ~/.zfunc ]]; then
  local _tv_ver="$(tv --version 2>/dev/null)"
  if [[ ! -f ~/.zfunc/_tv ]] || ! grep -q "${_tv_ver}" ~/.zfunc/_tv 2>/dev/null; then
    tv completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_tv 2>/dev/null
  fi
fi
```

**Pattern**: Same as worktrunk — version-check before regen.

#### Strategy 3: Eval-at-startup (standard tool init)

**File**: `dot_config/shell/10_fzf.sh` (shared, not shown in detail)

```bash
eval "$(fzf --zsh)"  # for zsh
eval "$(fzf --bash)" # for bash
```

**Pattern**:
- Tool provides `--zsh` / `--bash` flags that output completion script
- Eval'd directly in shell startup (no caching — tool itself may cache)
- No version tracking; tool controls versioning

**File**: `dot_config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` (lines 10-17)

```zsh
# Auto-generate shell completion into ~/.zfunc/ (regenerates on version change).
if [[ -d ~/.zfunc ]]; then
    local _sesh_ver="$(sesh --version 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ ! -f ~/.zfunc/_sesh ]] || ! grep -q "${_sesh_ver}" ~/.zfunc/_sesh 2>/dev/null; then
        sesh completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_sesh 2>/dev/null
    fi
fi
```

**Pattern**: Same version-check as worktrunk/television.

## SECTION D: Television Smart Autocomplete Integration

### Current television usage

**Key files**:
- `dot_config/zsh/tools/12_television.zsh` (lines 1-94): Channel keybindings (Alt+R/P/G/E/A/I), **NOT** tab-completion integration
- `dot_config/television/cable/*.toml`: 24 channel definitions (pueue, fleet-hosts, mlflow, etc.)

### Tab completion via `tv`

**Current state**: `tv completions zsh` generates a `_tv` function (written to `~/.zfunc/_tv` by line 30 of `12_television.zsh`). This handles **tv itself**, not other tools.

### Shell-integration smart autocomplete (the alternative feature)

**From the referenced docs**: https://alexpasmantier.github.io/television/user-guide/shell-integration/#configuring-autocompletion

Television offers **optional** TAB-key takeover via `tv init zsh` / `tv init bash`. This replaces readline/zle TAB with an fzf-style popup driven by `tv` channels. 

**Current repo decision**: **Explicitly disabled**

**Evidence**: `dot_config/zsh/tools/12_television.zsh:1-7`

```zsh
# Tab completion via ~/.zfunc/_tv (regenerated on version change).
# We do NOT use `tv init zsh` because it binds Ctrl+T and Ctrl+R,
# which conflict with fzf's shell integration.
#
# Instead, tv channels are bound to Alt keys:
#   Alt+R  tv shell history     (tv-style history search)
#   Alt+P  tv files             (tv-style file/path picker)
```

**Decision rationale**:
- `tv init zsh` binds `Ctrl+T` and `Ctrl+R`
- Conflicts with **fzf's shell integration** (which uses the same keys)
- fzf is higher priority (more established, users muscle-memory on it)
- tv channels delegated to Alt namespace instead (Alt+R for history, Alt+P for files, etc.)

**Impact on completion planning**:
- TAB key remains under fzf's control
- tv channels stay as dedicated Alt+key pickers, not TAB autocomplete
- Any in-house CLI completion should use standard `compdef` (zsh) / `complete -F` (bash), **not** tv channels

## SECTION E: Bash Completion Infrastructure

### Bash setup

**File**: `dot_config/bash/03_completion.bash` (lines 1-31)

```bash
# 03_completion.bash - bash-completion v2 source.
# Sourced from dot_bashrc.tmpl via load_modular_dir "$BASH_CONFIG_DIR" bash.
#
# Two cases:
#   1. Linux: /etc/bash_completion or /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion
#   2. macOS Homebrew: bash-completion@2 in $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/etc/profile.d/

# Skip on POSIX-strict mode (where bash-completion is unsupported).
shopt -oq posix && return 0

# 1. Linux distro completion
if [ -r /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion ]; then
    . /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion
elif [ -r /etc/bash_completion ]; then
    . /etc/bash_completion
fi

# 2. Homebrew bash-completion@2 (macOS, dynamic prefix)
if type brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    HB_PREFIX="$(brew --prefix 2>/dev/null)"
    if [ -n "$HB_PREFIX" ] && [ -r "$HB_PREFIX/etc/profile.d/bash_completion.sh" ]; then
        . "$HB_PREFIX/etc/profile.d/bash_completion.sh"
    fi
    unset HB_PREFIX
fi
```

### Bash completion directory

**Canonical location**: `${XDG_DATA_HOME}/bash-completion/completions/` (bash-completion v2 auto-loads `_<tool>` files from here on TAB)

**Default**: `~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/`

**Current repo state**: No bash-completion v2 completions are tracked by chezmoi.

### No bash-specific completion generation

Unlike zsh's `~/.zfunc/`, bash doesn't have a chezmoi-tracked completion path. The `03_completion.bash` file loads the system bash-completion v2 framework, but no in-house completion files are generated.

249	Subcommands under `fleet chezmoi`:

253	  status --live    Process-liveness probe

261	def _dispatch_chezmoi(forwarded: list[str]) -> int:
262	    """Route `fleet chezmoi <action> [args...]` to the chezmoi-backend helpers.
263	
264	    The top-level `apply`/`status`/`diff`/`tail`/`kill`/`compact` subcommands
265	    were removed on 2026-05-13 to free the top level for generic primitives
266	    (`tmux` / `info` / `pueue` / `exec`). All chezmoi-specific deploy ops
267	    live under this namespace now.
268	    """
269	    if not forwarded or forwarded[0] in ("-h", "--help", "help"):
270	        print(_CHEZMOI_ACTIONS)
271	        return 0
272	    action = forwarded[0]
273	    rest = forwarded[1:]
274	    nested = {
275	        "apply": _dispatch_apply,
276	        "status": _dispatch_status,
277	        "diff": _dispatch_diff,
278	        "tail": _dispatch_tail,
279	        "kill": _dispatch_kill,
280	        "compact": _dispatch_compact,
281	    }
282	    fn = nested.get(action)
283	    if fn is None:
284	        print(f"fleet chezmoi: unknown action '{action}'\n\n{_CHEZMOI_ACTIONS}", file=sys.stderr)

286	    return fn(rest)

302	        # Chezmoi-specific deploy ops under `fleet chezmoi <action>`.
303	        # The bare top-level names (apply/status/diff/tail/kill/compact) were
304	        # removed on 2026-05-13 — `fleet apply` now errors with "unknown
305	        # subcommand" by design so the namespace stays clean.
306	        "chezmoi": _dispatch_chezmoi,

308	        "edit": _dispatch_edit,
309	        # Generic cross-host primitives (deploy-tool-agnostic).
310	        "tmux": _dispatch_tmux,

312	        "pueue": _dispatch_pueue,

39	def make_client() -> "MlflowClient":
40	    """Build a MlflowClient. Imports lazily; silences mlflow's INFO logs.
41

50	    # installs its INFO-level handlers. The setLevel call below MUST run
51	    # after that, not before — pre-import setLevel gets overwritten.
52	    from mlflow.tracking import MlflowClient

204	def fetch_histories(
205	    client: "MlflowClient",
206	    run_id: str,
207	    keys: list[str],
208	) -> tuple[dict[str, tuple[list[int], list[float]]], list[tuple[str, str]]]:
209	    """Fetch metric history for every key. Skip-on-error per key.
210	
211	    Returns (series, skipped) where:
212	      series  = {key: (steps_sorted, values_aligned), ...}
213	      skipped = [(key, "ExceptionType: message"), ...]
214	
215	    One slow / broken key (commonly a `system.*` metric over a flaky link)
216	    shouldn't abort the whole batch — both the CLI `mlf plot` and the TUI
217	    Plot tab surface skipped keys in a separate warning instead. Bump
218	    MLFLOW_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT for the whole invocation if a host needs
219	    longer per-key reads.
220	    """
221	    series: dict[str, tuple[list[int], list[float]]] = {}
222	    skipped: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
223	    for key in keys:
224	        try:
225	            history = client.get_metric_history(run_id, key)
226	        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
227	            skipped.append((key, f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e).splitlines()[0][:80]}"))
228	            continue
229	        if not history:
230	            continue
231	        sorted_hist = sorted(history, key=lambda m: m.step)
232	        steps = [m.step for m in sorted_hist]
233	        values = [m.value for m in sorted_hist]
234	        series[key] = (steps, values)
235	    return series, skipped

186	def _parse_iso(ts: str | None) -> datetime | None:
187	    if not ts:

190	    if not m:

199	    else:

201	    try:
202	        return datetime.fromisoformat(normalised)
203	    except ValueError:

350	            eta = None
351	        else:
352	            eta = (gremaining * gavg) / parallel
353	
354	        gbreakdown: dict[str, int] = {}
355	        for t in gtasks:
356	            key = _breakdown_key(t)
357	            gbreakdown[key] = gbreakdown.get(key, 0) + 1
358	        failed_ids = [t.id for t in gtasks if t.status == "Done" and t.result and t.result != "Success"]
359	
360	        group_recs.append(GroupRec(
361	            name=gname,
362	            daemon_status=str(meta.get("status") or "N/A"),
363	            parallel_tasks=int(meta.get("parallel_tasks") or 1),
364	            total=gtotal,
365	            done=gdone,
366	            pct=(gdone * 100 / gtotal) if gtotal else 0.0,
367	            total_spent_s=spent,
368	            avg_done_s=gavg,
369	            eta_s=eta,
370	            status_breakdown=gbreakdown,
371	            failed_task_ids=failed_ids,
372	        ))
373	
374	    overall_eta_candidates = [g.eta_s for g in group_recs if g.eta_s is not None]
375	    overall_eta = max(overall_eta_candidates) if overall_eta_candidates else None
376	
377	    host = socket.gethostname().split(".")[0] or "host"
378	    return HostSnapshot(
379	        host=host,
380	        daemon_reachable=True,
381	        error=None,
382	        total_tasks=total,
383	        total_done=done,
384	        overall_pct=overall_pct,
385	        avg_done_s=avg_done,
386	        eta_s=overall_eta,
387	        status_breakdown=status_breakdown,
388	        groups=group_recs,
389	        tasks=tasks,
390	    )
391

393	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
394	# Text rendering — ports 36_pueue.zsh
395	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
396	def _fmt_duration(s: float | None) -> str:
397	    if s is None:
398	        return "-"
399	    s_int = int(s)
400	    if s_int < 60:
401	        return f"{s_int}s"
402	    if s_int < 3600:
403	        return f"{s_int // 60}m {s_int % 60}s"
404	    return f"{s_int // 3600}h {(s_int % 3600) // 60}m {s_int % 60}s"
405	
406	
407	def _fmt_pct(p: float) -> str:
408	    return f"{round(p * 10) / 10:.1f}%"
409	
410	
411	def _progress_bar(pct: float, width: int = 12) -> str:
412	    p = max(0, min(100, int(round(pct))))
413	    filled = p * width // 100
414	    empty = width - filled
415	    return "[" + "=" * filled + "-" * empty + "]"
416	
417	
418	def _breakdown_str(b: dict[str, int]) -> str:
419	    if not b:
420	        return "-"
421	    return ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(b.items()))
422	
423	
424	def render_text(snap: HostSnapshot, use_color: bool) -> None:
425	    out = Console(force_terminal=use_color, no_color=not use_color, soft_wrap=True)
426	    title = Text("Pueue Summary", style="bold cyan" if use_color else "")
427	    out.print(title)
428	    out.print(Text("Overall", style="bold cyan" if use_color else ""))
429	    out.print(f"  Total tasks: {snap.total_tasks}")
430	    bar = _progress_bar(snap.overall_pct)
431	    out.print(f"  Done progress: {snap.total_done}/{snap.total_tasks}  {bar}  {_fmt_pct(snap.overall_pct)}")
432	    out.print(f"  Avg done duration: {_fmt_duration(snap.avg_done_s)}")
433	    out.print(f"  Est. remaining (ETA): {_fmt_duration(snap.eta_s)}")
434	    out.print()
435	    out.print(Text("Status Breakdown", style="bold cyan" if use_color else ""))
436	    if not snap.status_breakdown:
437	        out.print("  -")
438	    else:
439	        tbl = Table(show_header=True, header_style="bold", box=None, pad_edge=False)
440	        tbl.add_column("status")
441	        tbl.add_column("count", justify="right")
442	        tbl.add_column("progress", justify="right")
443	        for k, v in sorted(snap.status_breakdown.items()):
444	            pct = (v * 100 / snap.total_tasks) if snap.total_tasks else 0.0
445	            tbl.add_row(k, str(v), _fmt_pct(pct))
446	        out.print(tbl)
447	    out.print()
448	    out.print(Text("Group Summary", style="bold cyan" if use_color else ""))
449	    if not snap.groups:
450	        out.print("  -")
451	        return
452	    gtbl = Table(show_header=True, header_style="bold", box=None, pad_edge=False)
453	    for col in ("group", "daemon", "parallel", "total", "done", "progress", "bar", "total_spent", "avg_done", "eta", "statuses"):
454	        gtbl.add_column(col)
455	    for g in snap.groups:
456	        gtbl.add_row(
457	            g.name,
458	            g.daemon_status,
459	            str(g.parallel_tasks),
460	            str(g.total),
461	            str(g.done),
462	            _fmt_pct(g.pct),
463	            _progress_bar(g.pct),
464	            _fmt_duration(g.total_spent_s),
465	            _fmt_duration(g.avg_done_s),
466	            _fmt_duration(g.eta_s),
467	            _breakdown_str(g.status_breakdown),
468	        )
469	    out.print(gtbl)
